title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities Hands-on performance marketing experience, including at least one role with meaningful D2C budget and business-result ownership. Direct experience managing purchase or revenue campaigns for a D2C, e-commerce, wellness, nutraceutical, Ayurveda, FMCG, beauty or personal-care brand. Strong Meta Ads Manager skills: campaign structure, Sales objective, Advantage+ tools, audience strategy, creative testing, retargeting, exclusions, budget control and attribution interpretation. Strong Google Ads skills: Search, Performance Max/Shopping where eligible, YouTube, remarketing, keyword and negative-keyword control, bidding and conversion setup. Working proficiency with Shopify Analytics, GA4, GTM, Meta Pixel, Conversions API, event deduplication, UTMs and spreadsheet reporting. Ability to read business numbers including AOV, conversion rate, CAC, contribution margin, prepaid mix, cancellation, NDR, RTO, repeat purchase and LTV. Ability to brief and assess UGC and ad creatives based on hooks, retention, click intent, conversion quality and fatiguenot personal taste alone. Experience leading internal team members, external agencies, freelancers or creators with clear targets, review cadences and accountability. Comfort working from the Sahibabad/Ghaziabad office and coordinating daily with design, sales, customer support and logistics teams. Clear written communication, disciplined reporting, high ownership and willingness to explain both winning and losing decisions. 
 Preferred candidate profile Managed at least 1030 lakh in monthly advertising spend with independently verifiable ownership and budget accountability. Experience reducing COD cancellations or RTO through confirmation flows, audience exclusions, offer changes or courier/pincode analysis. Experience with product feeds, Merchant Center, WhatsApp/CRM attribution, call conversions or marketplace advertising. Google Ads, GA4 or Meta certification; certification supports but does not replace live operating evidence.

Key Skills: Growth Marketing,Performance Marketing,Marketing,Management,Performance
